brief:
The U.S. ambassador characterized an assault on a Washington Post photographer by Israeli settlers as an act of terrorism committed by cowards, according to Maan Wire. The photographer was attacked while covering events in the occupied West Bank.

The ambassador's statement represents a rare direct condemnation of settler violence from a senior U.S. official, using language typically reserved for formal designations of militant activity.
title: U.S. envoy calls settler attack on Washington Post photographer terrorism
